translation:
(This passage's argument is precise and unmatched; students should be able to penetrate it thoroughly, and then all diseases will be understood. Yet Xu Lingtai and Chen Xiuyuan always disparage Ye Tianshi's discussion of freeing the network vessels; why? A whole Original Patterns of Disease (原病式) only explains the four characters "channel network qi transformation" (經絡氣化).)

Hence I wrote the Original Patterns of Disease (原病式), saying: the sweat pores of the skin are the apertures that discharge sweat. One name, the qi gate (氣門), is the portal that discharges qi. One name, the interstices (腠理), is the texture and pattern of the pathways of qi and fluids.
translator_notes: 徐靈胎/陳修園/葉天士 kept as personal names (Xu Lingtai, Chen Xiuyuan, Ye Tianshi).
經絡氣化 rendered as channel network qi transformation.
